title: Common type definitions for the trains_magazines corpus

MagazineKey.description: Opaque key identifying a magazine title in the corpus.

IssueKey.description: Opaque key identifying a single issue of a magazine. Currently always YYYY-MM (e.g. "1982-03"), but the format may broaden to accommodate seasonally published titles.

PdfPageNumber.description: 1-based index of a page within a PDF file. Determined by the curator who scanned the original paper copy; may include incidental pages such as tear-out cards that do not correspond to any printed_page_number.

PrintedPageNumber.description: Page number as it appeared on the physical printed page. Purely numeric for regular pages (e.g. "42"); suffixed with one or more lowercase letters for insert sections (e.g. "30b"). Uppercase-prefixed for named supplements — with hyphen (e.g. "R-12" for the Kalmbach Resource Guide) or without (e.g. "D1", "D2" for club directory sections). In older issues, numbering may continue across months within a year rather than resetting per issue.
